name.ja: Bトレインショーティー 伊豆箱根鉄道3000系　ラブライブ！サンシャイン!! ラッピング電車　HAPPY PARTY TRAIN 1
name.en: B Train Shorty Izu Hakone Railway 3000 Series Love Live! Sunshine!! Wrapping train HAPPY PARTY TRAIN 1

ja: 2017年に運行し大好評を博したラッピング電車第１弾に引き続き、３rd シングル「HAPPY PARTY TRAIN」の発売（４月５日）に合わせて、フルラッピングで運行された伊豆箱根鉄道3000系がBトレに登場！
先頭車前面に貼れるヘッドマークステッカー全10種付き！
3年生の美麗イラストが入った1号車クハ3506です！
en: Following the first wrapped train that was operated in 2017 and received great acclaim, the Izu Hakone Railway 3000 series, which was operated in full wrapping, is now available in B-Train in conjunction with the release of the 3rd single "HAPPY PARTY TRAIN" (45)!
Comes with 10 types of head mark stickers that can be pasted on the front of the lead car!
1st car Kuha 3506 with beautiful illustrations of 3rd generation!
